name: BYD Seal (Performance AWD)
summary: The BYD Seal Performance AWD is an electric sports sedan in Pakistan distributed by Mega Motor Co (Hubco). Featuring an 82.56 kWh Blade battery, dual-motor 523 hp powertrain, and 570 km range, it accelerates from 0-100 km/h in 3.8 seconds with 150 kW DC charging.

name: BYD Atto 3 (Extended Range)
summary: The BYD Atto 3 is an all-electric compact SUV distributed by Mega Motor Co in Pakistan. Equipped with a 49.92 kWh ultra-safe Blade battery and 201 hp motor, it offers a 410 km range, rotating infotainment, and 88 kW fast charging for urban and intercity commutes.

name: Deepal S07 (Smart Electric SUV)
summary: The Deepal S07 is a premium mid-size electric SUV assembled and backed by Master Changan in Pakistan. Powered by a 66.8 kWh battery delivering 485 km range and 255 hp, it features an AR-HUD heads-up display, frameless doors, and 92 kW fast DC charging.

name: Deepal L07 (Electric Sport Sedan)
summary: The Deepal L07 is an aerodynamic electric sports sedan brought to Pakistan by Master Changan. With a 66.8 kWh battery pack delivering 530 km CLTC range and 255 hp rear-wheel drive, it includes an electric active spoiler, sunflower touchscreen, and 0-100 km/h in 5.9 seconds.

name: Honri VE 2.0
summary: The Honri VE 2.0 is an affordable urban electric microcar assembled in Pakistan by Dewan Motors. Featuring an 18.5 kWh lithium iron phosphate battery and 40 hp motor, it offers a 200 km range, 7-hour home wall-socket charging, and unmatched running economy.

name: Honri VE 3.0 (Long Range)
summary: The Honri VE 3.0 is an extended-range urban EV assembled by Dewan Motors in Pakistan. Carrying an enlarged 29.9 kWh LFP battery, it delivers an extended 300 km driving range, enhanced touchscreen infotainment, and low operational expenses for Pakistani city commuters.

name: Gugo Motors Gigi EV
summary: The Gugo Gigi EV is a compact, retro-modern city hatchback distributed in Pakistan by GuGo Motors. Featuring a 16.8 kWh battery pack and 40 hp motor, it yields a 220 km NEDC range, dual dashboard displays, and seamless domestic charging compatibility.

name: MG4 EV (Essence 64 kWh)
summary: The MG4 EV Essence is a rear-wheel-drive electric hot hatch distributed by JW Auto Park in Pakistan. Engineered on the MSP modular platform with a 64 kWh battery and 201 hp output, it achieves 435 km range and ultra-fast 140 kW DC charging.

name: MG ZS EV (Long Range)
summary: The MG ZS EV is a family-oriented electric crossover officially marketed by JW Auto Park across Pakistan. Featuring a 51.1 kWh water-cooled battery pack producing 174 hp, it delivers a 320 km WLTP range with panoramic sunroof and CCS2 motorway compatibility.

name: MG HS PHEV
summary: The MG HS PHEV is a plug-in hybrid SUV distributed by JW Auto Park in Pakistan. Combining a 1.5L Turbo petrol engine with a 16.6 kWh battery, it delivers 258 combined hp, 135 km of pure EV city driving, and over 1,000 km total range.

name: Dongfeng Box (Nammi 01)
summary: The Dongfeng Box is a chic electric city hatchback brought to Pakistan by GuGo Motors. Featuring frameless doors, a 31.45 kWh LFP battery, and 94 hp electric motor, it provides 330 km range, 50 kW fast charging, and Level 2 driver assistance.

name: Omoda E5 (Pure Electric Crossover)
summary: The Omoda E5 is a futuristic all-electric crossover distributed in Pakistan by Chery and Ghandhara. Sporting a 61 kWh battery and 204 hp powertrain, it offers a 430 km range, Sony premium audio, curved dual screens, and 80 kW DC fast charging.

name: KIA EV5 (Air / Earth)
summary: The KIA EV5 is an upcoming mid-size electric SUV introduced to Pakistan through Lucky Motor Corp. Built on the dedicated E-GMP architecture with an 88.1 kWh battery and 215 hp motor, it offers a 530 km range and innovative lounge-style seating.

name: Mercedes-Benz EQS 450+ SUV
summary: The Mercedes-Benz EQS 450+ SUV is a flagship luxury electric vehicle imported via Shahnawaz Ltd. Equipped with a colossal 118 kWh battery delivering 600 km range, it features the 56-inch MBUX Hyperscreen, AIRMATIC air suspension, and 200 kW ultra-fast charging.

name: Audi Q8 55 e-tron quattro
summary: The Audi Q8 55 e-tron quattro is a premier electric luxury SUV imported by Premier Systems in Pakistan. Featuring a 114 kWh high-capacity battery, dual-motor 402 hp quattro AWD, and 582 km range, it supports 170 kW DC motorway hyper-speed charging.

name: Audi e-tron 50 quattro
summary: The Audi e-tron 50 quattro is an electric executive SUV officially backed by Premier Systems in Pakistan. With a 71 kWh battery producing 308 hp and 336 km WLTP range, it offers legendary quattro all-wheel drive, air suspension, and refined German build quality.

name: BMW i4 eDrive40 Gran Coupe
summary: The BMW i4 eDrive40 is a four-door electric Gran Coupe imported into Pakistan via Dewan Motors. Boasting an 83.9 kWh slim battery, 335 hp rear-wheel drive, and 590 km range, it pairs quintessential BMW driving dynamics with up to 205 kW DC fast charging.

name: Tesla Model 3 (Long Range AWD)
summary: The Tesla Model 3 Long Range is a popular imported electric sedan in Pakistan. Featuring dual-motor all-wheel drive, 491 hp, and a 75 kWh battery delivering 629 km range, it features Autopilot convenience, minimalist cabin tech, and 250 kW Supercharging capability.

name: Tesla Model Y (Standard Range RWD)
summary: The Tesla Model Y Standard Range is an imported electric crossover in Pakistan offering spacious cabin dimensions. Powered by a 60 kWh LFP battery generating 295 hp, it achieves 455 km WLTP range with unmatched storage versatility and active Autopilot tech.

name: BYD Sealion 7 (Performance AWD)
summary: The BYD Sealion 7 is an upcoming mid-size fastback electric SUV slated for Pakistan through Mega Motor Co. Powered by a 91.3 kWh Blade battery and 523 hp AWD system, it achieves 550 km range with innovative e-Platform 3.0 Evo and 230 kW DC charge rates.

name: Chery Tiggo 7 Pro PHEV
summary: The Chery Tiggo 7 Pro PHEV is an advanced plug-in hybrid SUV distributed in Pakistan by Ghandhara Nissan. Combining a 1.5L Turbo engine with dual electric motors, it outputs 342 hp and 1,200 km range with 90 km EV capability and 40 kW DC charging.

name: Chery Tiggo 8 Pro e+ (7-Seater PHEV)
summary: The Chery Tiggo 8 Pro e+ is a 7-seater plug-in hybrid SUV distributed by Ghandhara Nissan in Pakistan. Featuring a 3-motor DHT hybrid system producing 322 hp, a 19.27 kWh battery, and 1,000 km range, it suits large families seeking hybrid fuel economy.

name: Forthing Friday REEV
summary: The Forthing Friday REEV is a range-extended electric crossover available in Pakistan. Featuring a 31.2 kWh battery and on-board generator, it delivers 201 hp, 220 km pure electric driving, and 1,150 km combined intercity range with fast DC charging capability.

name: Jaecoo J7 SHS (Super Hybrid)
summary: The Jaecoo J7 SHS is an off-road styled hybrid SUV introduced by Chery in Pakistan. Packing a 33.67 kWh battery pack, all-terrain ARDIS drive system, and 342 hp output, it yields 190 km of EV commuting and 1,250 km combined distance with 45 kW DC fast charge.

name: Changan Nevo Hunter 4WD REEV
summary: The Changan Nevo Hunter 4WD REEV is Pakistan's first range-extended electric pickup truck from Master Changan. Powered by dual electric motors outputting 268 hp and a 31.18 kWh battery, it achieves 131 km EV range and 1,031 km overall range with heavy cargo capability.

name: GWM Haval H6 HEV (Self-Charging)
summary: The GWM Haval H6 HEV is an assembled-in-Pakistan self-charging hybrid SUV distributed by Sazgar. Featuring a 1.5L Turbo engine and electric DHT transmission generating 240 hp, it returns exceptional fuel efficiency of 18-20 km/L without requiring plug-in charging.

name: GWM Ora 03 (Good Cat)
summary: The GWM Ora 03 is a retro-futuristic electric hatchback assembled and distributed by Sazgar in Pakistan. Featuring a 47.78 kWh LFP battery producing 141 hp, it achieves a 400 km range with retro round LED headlights, high-end upholstery, and CCS2 charging.

name: GAC Aion V
summary: The GAC Aion V is an intelligent mid-size electric crossover imported to Pakistan. Featuring a 75.3 kWh Magazine Battery pack and 201 hp motor, it provides a 500 km range, advanced smart-cabin tech, and comfortable family-friendly ground clearance.

name: Seres 3 EV
summary: The Seres 3 EV is an electric compact crossover assembled in Pakistan by Regal Automobiles. Equipped with a 53.61 kWh LFP battery and 161 hp motor, it achieves a 405 km NEDC range, 360-degree cameras, and convenient 50 kW fast DC charging.

name: JMEV EV3 (Youth Edition)
summary: The JMEV EV3 is an economical 5-door electric urban microcar imported into Pakistan. Featuring a 31.1 kWh battery and 48 hp electric motor, it achieves 270 km range with front power windows, touch entertainment, and compact city maneuvering.

name: Zeekr X (Long Range AWD)
summary: The Zeekr X is an ultra-modern luxury compact electric crossover imported into Pakistan. Powered by a 66 kWh battery and dual motors delivering 422 hp, it rockets from 0-100 km/h in 3.8s with a sliding infotainment screen and Yamaha 13-speaker sound.

name: Riddara RD6 (Electric Pickup)
summary: The Riddara RD6 by Geely is an all-electric lifestyle pickup truck imported to Pakistan. Featuring an 86 kWh battery pack and 272 hp rear-wheel drive, it achieves 550 km CLTC range with a 6 kW bed-mounted V2L power panel for tools and outdoor appliances.
